gap: At the peak (v6.314) the right half is a muddy, low-contrast double exposure: the about-wall cards (portrait, coursework, 3.49 badge) ghost over the room's window at equal weight, so it reads as a crossfade through beige haze rather than the flare swallowing the wall and the room emerging out of it.
notes: Big improvement: warm sun blob upper-left, room established by 6.42 with window, floor light pools, dust and the SPEX card; 6.65 matches the bar's golden mood. Flare itself still lacks lens character (one faint horizontal streak, one soft ghost disc; no anamorphic/chromatic ghosts trailing across frame). Exposure ramp mostly smooth, but 6.207 to 6.314 is the biggest single jump in brightness, and the room keeps darkening noticeably 6.529 to 6.743 as the haze lifts. Beams/ceiling only read late (6.636+). No console errors, no failed chapters.
